title: Uncertainty-aware link lifetime prediction and proactive routing for UAV swarms: simulation code and results (v1.0.0)
description: Python simulation code, raw JSON results and figure sources for the manuscript 'Uncertainty-Aware Link Lifetime Prediction and Proactive Routing for Reliable UAV Swarm Communications' (submitted to MDPI Drones). Implements risk-calibrated lifetime-aware routing (RCLR): a lower-quantile model of the residual UAV-to-UAV link lifetime with one-sided conformal calibration, adaptive conformal inference, hop-constrained widest-path routing with proactive switching, all baselines and simplified re-implementations of the routing decision rules of LB-OPAR, OLSR+, LPAR and LPMD-GPSR.
